title: Grateful Dead Live at McGaw Memorial Hall, Northwestern U. on 1973-11-01
source: Set 2 Source: Soundboard > Master-Reel > Reel (1st gen) > DAT (44.1k)

ai_review.summary: Super‑crisp soundboard recording of a smoking, high‑energy set with a standout “Morning Dew” performance.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as the cleanest on the Archive – a soundboard capture that’s crisp and virtually distortion‑free, especially highlighting Phil Lesh’s thundering bass. The show itself is described as a nonstop, smoking sequence of tunes at the band’s peak, with “Morning Dew” singled out as a highlight.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviewers gave five‑star ratings and consistently praised both the musical performance (high energy, smoking set) and the technical quality (super crisp soundboard, clean bass). The weighted average of show (≈4.8) and recording (≈5.0) yields a strong 4.8 rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as “super crispy”, “cleanest recording yet”, with almost no distortion and crystal‑clear bass response.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A seamless, high‑energy sequence that keeps giving; reviewers call the set “smokin’” and note its continuous flow.

band_member_comments.Phil: Phil's bass is highlighted as thundering, clean and virtually distortion‑free.
